_doc: Ground truth for the multi-role authz fixture. Personas: alice(team-alpha), bob(team-beta). Entity: submission, owningChain [team], roleScope {alice:owns, bob:none for the OTHER team}. The leak: Bob is not filtered and sees team-alpha's S1/S3.

seeds.title: Bob (team-beta) can see team-alpha's submissions (S1, S3) — cross-role/tenant isolation leak; he must see none of another team's submissions
seeds.oracle: logged in as bob, the submissions list must NOT contain any submission whose team != bob's team (team-beta); S1/S3 (team-alpha) present = leak

seeds.title: Alice correctly sees ONLY team-alpha submissions (S1, S3), never team-beta's S2 — correct isolation, MUST NOT be flagged
Public announcements (A1, A2) are shared with all users by design — MUST NOT be flagged as a cross-role leak
